headline: Special late edition: What is Keith cooking?
interpretation: The message gives away the ambition and leaves us hungry for the recipe. Keith has made his move on the board. Now the question for the next installment: what is he cooking?

sections.text: Keith Tyser has dropped a teaser for both ARC races. After climbing into the ARC-3 public gold places, he says he thinks he has found the secret sauce — and it seems to work on ARC-AGI-2 as well. That is a message worth stopping the presses for.

In a message shared with the Digest by publisher Mark Barney, Tyser wrote: “Haha thanks! Love the Daily Digest idea btw. Such a fun way to keep up with the competition. Saw you guys made a big jump too! I think I’ve finally found the secret sauce, and it seems to work for both ARC 2 and 3 👀”

The scorecard gives the tease some bite. His keithtyser entry climbed from 70th to 14th in the past day, adding 4.48 points to reach 37.22 and land inside ARC-3’s 18 public gold places. On ARC-2, his account is listed with ARC Raiders, the team sitting 8th at 58.75. Two contests, two entries, and now a hint that the same sauce travels.
